  • スコア: 6.4/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 性春謳歌
  • 英語名: Seishun Ouka

あらすじ

The protagonist is a college Ronin who lives with his father. With the college entrance exam just one month away his father suddenly remarries, and now he has a step mother and two step sisters.

In this multi-scenario game overflowing with guilty pleasure, you have just one month to sneak around behind your fathers back and make your step mother and step sisters yours.

あらすじ

The protagonist has just been accepted into a university in Hokkaido, and in two weeks he’ll leave behind his familiar home town to commute there.

His father has been out of the country due to work, and he has been in charge of the house along with his step-sister. His impending departure has made him think about her in ways he never has before. And his step-sister, who has long had feelings for him, has become more proactive…

あらすじ

In the sequel to Sei Shōjo Sentai Lakers II Akira and his team have successfully fended off Rayott’s assault and are enjoying a brief peaceful time. item.title: Reijuu - Twin Road
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Apple Pie

  • 日本語名: 麗獣 ツインロード
  • 英語名: Reijuu - Twin Road

あらすじ

The town of Jester is located near a spring, which is used both by humans from the town and the beast people from their forest village. For years, the two races co-existed in peace. But one day, somebody sets the Jester tavern on fire. The authorities arrest a young beast girl who happened to be in the town at that time. Outraged by the injustice, a young orphan boy named Kein, who was raised by Tyrone, one of the town knights, convinces him to help the girl escape. But that act draws the ire of the town authorities, and the heroes realize that they have to flee…

item.title: Metal Mover Jastrike
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Apple Pie
  • 発売日: 1995-08-11
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: メタルムーバー ジャストライク
  • 英語名: Metal Mover Jastrike

あらすじ

During the first few decades of the space era, humanity was able to exist in a relative peace. But soon rogue organizations collectively known as space pirates began to terrorize space stations. This led to a series of violent conflicts. Both sides developed various types of giant mechs operated by human pilots, called “Metal Movers”. A special police force was founded to combat the pirates. The young pilot Gingie and his lovely companion Windy must defend the space station and eventually venture into enemy territory.

  • 英語名: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers II

别名

  • Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers II

あらすじ

The sequel to Sei Shōjo Sentai Lakers directly continues the story from the previous game. Akira and his team of school girls with supernatural powers have repelled Galvan’s forces and protected the Laker Crystals. However, a new adversary named Rayott appears on the stage. Obtaining his power from Leticia, the former commander of the Gadram Empire, Rayott intends to use the power of the crystals in order to invade Earth.

あらすじ

The Guild Master and the Protectors of the Elements had the best intentions. All they wanted was to use the Grand Card in order to summon the Grand Master who would protect the world, just like the legends said. Surely they could not predict would would happen.   • 英語名: Metamorph Meena

别名

  • Metamor Meena

あらすじ

In “Metamorph Meena” the player controls Mai, a little girl who has a crush on an older boy who, naturally, doesn’t pay any attention to her. But one day she meets two imp-like creatures, one of whom is Pal, the 153rd prince of a magical world called Dream Star, and the other his court magician Pul. The two turn Mai into an adult young woman, and she begins to explore her newly found sexuality…

item.title: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Apple Pie
  • 発売日: 1993-12-25
  • スコア: 5.29/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 聖少女戦隊レイカーズ
  • 英語名: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers

别名

  • 聖少女戦隊レイカーズ

あらすじ

Akira Daidōji was just an ordinary teenager until one night he had a strange dream. When he woke up he was contacted by a mysterious stranger from another planet who told him that the Gadram Empire is attacking his homeland because they need the power of the so-called Laker Crystals to survive. Akira was chosen as the next guardian of the crystals. In order to defeat Galvan, the dark leader of Gadram, Akira has to discover five young girls with special powers and assemble a team for the upcoming battle.

item.title: Dengeki Division
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Apple Pie
  • 発売日: 1993-11-13
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Dengeki Division
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The powerful god known as Black B was securely sealed, preventing his powers from corrupting humans. The people of the Kingdom enjoyed a prosperous, peaceful life. But that ended when the nearby country, ruled by a ruthless Empress, heard of the sealed god. The Empire attacked the Kingdom, which had no other choice but release Black B and use his powers to defend themselves. Black B readily agreed to help, on one condition: all the generals in his army must be female…
